from solution import comb_sort


def test_issue_example():
    """Issue example: comb_sort([5, 15, 37, 25, 79]) == [5, 15, 25, 37, 79]."""
    # hand-sorted: 5 < 15 < 25 < 37 < 79 so expected [5, 15, 25, 37, 79]
    assert comb_sort([5, 15, 37, 25, 79]) == [5, 15, 25, 37, 79]


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles empty input."""
    # hand-sorted: no elements to order, 0 == 0 so expected []
    assert comb_sort([]) == []


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles one element."""
    # hand-sorted: single 42 alone so 42 == 42 gives expected [42]
    assert comb_sort([42]) == [42]


def test_issue_two_elements_unsorted():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles two unsorted items."""
    # hand-sorted: 1 < 2 so expected [1, 2]
    assert comb_sort([2, 1]) == [1, 2]


def test_issue_already_sorted():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort keeps sorted input sorted."""
    # hand-sorted: 1 < 2 < 3 < 4 so expected [1, 2, 3, 4]
    assert comb_sort([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_issue_reverse_sorted():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort reverses descending input."""
    # hand-sorted: 1 < 2 < 3 < 4 < 5 so expected [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert comb_sort([5, 4, 3, 2, 1]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]


def test_issue_duplicates():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles duplicate values."""
    # hand-sorted: 1 = 1 < 2 < 3 = 3 so expected [1, 1, 2, 3, 3]
    assert comb_sort([3, 1, 2, 1, 3]) == [1, 1, 2, 3, 3]


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles negative numbers."""
    # hand-sorted: -5 < -2 < 0 < 1 < 3 so expected [-5, -2, 0, 1, 3]
    assert comb_sort([-5, 3, -2, 0, 1]) == [-5, -2, 0, 1, 3]


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Issue: sort a list of elements using comb sort handles all-equal input."""
    # hand-sorted: 7 = 7 = 7 so expected [7, 7, 7]
    assert comb_sort([7, 7, 7]) == [7, 7, 7]


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Contract: example compares result to a list so comb_sort must return a list."""
    # hand order check: 1 < 2 < 3 so expected sorted form [1, 2, 3] is a list
    result = comb_sort([3, 1, 2])
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_preserves_elements():
    """Contract: sorting a list must not add or drop elements."""
    # hand-sorted: 1 < 2 < 3 < 4 so expected [1, 2, 3, 4] with 3 + 1 = 4 items
    assert sorted(comb_sort([4, 1, 3, 2])) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
